sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar.
Our orders of part:370010 were placed at 5.17 (po:4500013023-10, 2025-10) and 5.45 EUR (po:4500014455-10, 2026-09).
Your letter of 2026-07-06 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) says your material is covered until March 2027.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 94,800 kg per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.48 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We thank you for your commitment to a binding volume of 94,800 kg per year over 24 months, which enables us to revise our pricing.
We have selected your second package, incorporating the AS-14404 index and a 24-month contract term, to ensure mutual planning security.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you very much for your continued interest in our products and for working with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. 

We are pleased to present our Angebot for a price of €5.25 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that a longer Zahlungsziel costs us interest, and that is priced in. Furthermore, the contract term is reflected in the price. A Preisgleitklausel changes who carries the material risk, which is also priced in. 

Please be aware that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stays valid for 7 days. We truly value our business relationship and look forward to serving your needs from our extensive range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

reasons: A longer Zahlungsziel costs us interest; that is priced in.
The contract term is reflected in the price.
A Preisgleitklausel changes who carries the material risk; priced in.
